summary.en: Houthis have stepped up missile and drone attacks on Saudi Arabia, striking an airport, targeting Saudi Aramco facilities, and prompting Saudi air strikes on Houthi sites in Yemen. Iran is accused of planning attacks on UK military sites, with MI5 warning of a shift toward harder targets and the UK sanctioning two Iranian nationals after an alleged IRGC plot at RAF Fairford. Iranian officials claim some incidents are false-flag operations following the UK accusations. The conflict now reaches Saudi oil infrastructure, regional air travel, and UK security concerns, with 123 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
